how_to_refresh: Each month, open https://www.schoolnutritionandfitness.com/index.php?sid=1571761233982&page=menus (keep the sid), click 'AUSD Elementary Lunch Menu' for the new month (downloadMenu.php link id changes monthly), accept the disclaimer in the webmenus2 viewer, use PDF/Print > 'Calendar Without Images' to get the PDF, and transcribe the calendar into a new YYYY-MM.json file. The in-viewer calendar may render empty and its Accessible View may wrongly say 'No menus published' — trust the PDF. Weekends are never listed; blank weekdays mean no school that day.
